#include <bits/stdc++.h>
using namespace std;

struct Vec {
    static constexpr double EPS = 1e-9;
    double x, y;

    Vec(double x_=0, double y_=0) : x(x_), y(y_) {}

    Vec add(const Vec& o) const {
        return Vec(x + o.x, y + o.y);
    }

    Vec sub(const Vec& o) const {
        return Vec(x - o.x, y - o.y);
    }

    Vec scale(double s) const {
        return Vec(x * s, y * s);
    }

    double dot(const Vec& o) const {
        return x * o.x + y * o.y;
    }

    double mag2() const {
        return dot(*this);
    }

    double mag() const {
        return sqrt(mag2());
    }

    Vec unit() const {
        double m = mag();
        if (m < EPS) return Vec(0, 0);
        return scale(1.0 / m);
    }

    Vec rot90() const {
        return Vec(-y, x);
    }

    Vec rot270() const {
        return Vec(y, -x);
    }

    bool equals(const Vec& o) const {
        return (fabs(x - o.x) < EPS) && (fabs(y - o.y) < EPS);
    }

    string toString() const {
        char buf[50];
        snprintf(buf, sizeof(buf), "(%.2f, %.2f)", x, y);
        return string(buf);
    }
};

struct Circle {
    Vec c;
    double r;

    Circle(const Vec& c_, double r_) : c(c_), r(r_) {}

    vector<Vec> intersect(const Circle& o) const {
        if (c.equals(o.c)) return {};
        Vec d = o.c.sub(c);
        double dist2 = d.mag2();
        double dist = sqrt(dist2);
        if (r + o.r < dist + Vec::EPS || r + dist < o.r + Vec::EPS || o.r + dist < r + Vec::EPS) return {};
        if (fabs(r + o.r - dist) < Vec::EPS)
            return { c.add(d.scale(r / dist)) };
        if (fabs(o.r + dist - r) < Vec::EPS)
            return { c.sub(d.scale(r / dist)) };
        if (fabs(r + dist - o.r) < Vec::EPS)
            return { c.sub(d.scale(r / dist)) };

        double d1 = (r * r + dist2 - o.r * o.r) / (2 * dist);
        double h = sqrt(max(0.0, r * r - d1 * d1));
        Vec uDir = d.unit();
        Vec rInt = c.add(uDir.scale(d1).add(uDir.rot90().scale(h)));
        Vec lInt = c.add(uDir.scale(d1).add(uDir.rot270().scale(h)));
        return { rInt, lInt };
    }
};

int main() {
    ios::sync_with_stdio(false);
    cin.tie(nullptr);
    int n; cin >> n;
    vector<Circle> circles(n);
    for (int i = 0; i < n; i++) {
        double x, y; int r;
        cin >> x >> y >> r;
        circles[i] = Circle(Vec(x, y), r);
    }

    vector<Vec> points;
    vector<int> parent(n);
    for (int i = 0; i < n; i++) parent[i] = i;

    int totalCount = 1;
    for (int i = 0; i < n; i++) {
        vector<Vec> newPoints;
        for (int j = 0; j < n; j++) {
            if (i == j) continue;
            vector<Vec> inters = circles[i].intersect(circles[j]);
            if (inters.empty()) continue;
            int a = parent[i] = parent[parent[i]];
            int b = parent[j] = parent[parent[j]];
            parent[a] = b;
            for (const Vec& v : inters) {
                bool exists = false;
                for (const Vec& e : newPoints) {
                    if (v.equals(e)) {
                        exists = true;
                        break;
                    }
                }
                if (!exists) newPoints.push_back(v);
            }
        }
        totalCount += (int)newPoints.size();
        for (const Vec& v : newPoints) {
            bool found = false;
            for (const Vec& e : points) {
                if (v.equals(e)) {
                    found = true;
                    break;
                }
            }
            if (!found) points.push_back(v);
        }
    }
    totalCount -= (int)points.size();

    for (int i = 0; i < n; i++) {
        totalCount += 1 - (int)fabs(i - parent[i]) / fabs(i - parent[i] + 1e-15);
    }

    cout << totalCount << "\n";

    return 0;
}
